title: Add Discussion panel to Console Drawer for visibility
body:
Integrates a fully functional `RecordChatterPanel` into the NavigationOverlay Drawer in `ObjectView.tsx` and changes the default navigation mode to `'page'`, ensuring discussion/collaboration features are always accessible.

## Changes Made

- **DrawerDetailContent component**: Extracted the Drawer overlay content into a dedicated `DrawerDetailContent` React component (required to use hooks inside the NavigationOverlay render prop). This component includes full data fetching for persisted comments from `sys_comment`, and provides `handleAddComment`, `handleAddReply`, and `handleToggleReaction` handlers with backend persistence — matching the functionality of `RecordDetailView`.
- **RecordChatterPanel in Drawer**: Added a collapsible (default collapsed) discussion panel below the `DetailView` inside the Drawer overlay, with reactions, threading, and comment input enabled.
- **Default navigation mode**: Changed the default `detailNavigation` from `{ mode: 'drawer' }` to `{ mode: 'page' }`, so clicking a record row navigates to the full `RecordDetailView` page by default. Objects and views can still explicitly configure `{ mode: 'drawer' }` if needed.
- **Tests**: Added tests to verify the ChatterPanel renders inside the drawer overlay when navigation mode is set to `'drawer'`, and that the default navigation mode is `'page'`.

## Testing

- ✅ All 33 existing ObjectView tests pass (1 skipped, pre-existing)
- ✅ CodeQL security scan: 0 alerts
- ✅ New tests validate drawer ChatterPanel presence and default page navigation mode

> <issue_description>## 发现的问题
> 
> ### 问题一：Drawer 中未集成 Discussion/Chatter 面板
> 在 Console 实际点击记录行（如 Contact/Account 等）时，默认会弹出 Drawer 侧边栏，而不是跳转到详情（RecordDetailView）页面。Drawer 内目前只集成了 DetailView，**并没有包含 RecordChatterPanel、评论、activity timeline 等讨论面板**。因此用户日常操作下根本看不到评论/协作功能。
> 
> - 参考代码：`apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx`，Drawer 的 NavigationOverlay 渲染内容。
> - 期望结果：Drawer 中详情下方也应有完整的讨论面板（可折叠）。
> 
> ### 问题二：默认导航模式配置为 'drawer'，而不是 'page'
> 当前对象的明细点击后默认以 Drawer 方式预览详情。只有显示为 'page' 模式时才会跳转进入支持评论的 `RecordDetailView` 页面。
> 
> - 参考代码：`ObjectView.tsx` 中 detailNavigation 默认值 `{ mode: "drawer" }`
> - 期望修正：如需全页评论协作，建议默认 navigation.mode 改为 'page'，或让对象可定制该行为。
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 建议修改方案
> 1. **Drawer 集成 ChatterPanel**：在 Drawer 的详情视图下方同步集成与 RecordDetailView 一致的 RecordChatterPanel/Feed/ActivityTimeline，合理收缩默认可折叠。
> 2. **导航默认为 Page**：如大部分业务习惯全页评论交流，建议默认 navigation.mode = 'page'（实在需要 Drawer 行为再配置）。如需兼容历史，建议项目 README 加说明。
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 修复完成后校验：
> - Drawer/页面详情都能展示评论/讨论面板，体验一致；
> - 打开任何行记录详情都能评论、查看活动流。
